annotations.title: Check Game Server Mod and Plugin Updates

description: Check the installed mods (kind=mods) or plugins (kind=plugins) of a gameserver for newer versions. Install an update with install_gameserver_mod / install_gameserver_plugin and the reported versionId. refresh=true asks the providers again even for cached answers. Read-only. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: check_gameserver_addon_updates
